::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 9th [1886]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 147-8
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

The printer can judge better than I but I do not think there is enough of [the Quest of Ulysses](cmy_books/cmybook_185.qmd) to make more than such a volume as [the Little Duke](cmy_books/cmybook_20.qmd), so I think it had better belong to that Series.

Thank you for Lord Albemarles’ [memoirs](other_books/otherbook_1008.qmd). I was waiting to do so till I saw what [Mudie](organizations/other_137.qmd) sent me, and his box is either delayed or lost, as I have just discovered.

I will not close this letter till I hear the result of the enquiry I have sent to make at the Parcels’ Office. If I do not get the books today, I think I must ask you to let me have the [Queens Journals](other_books/otherbook_1009.qmd) the [Greville Memoirs](other_books/otherbook_1002.qmd)  [Princess Alice](other_books/otherbook_1010.qmd), and [Lady Blomfield](other_books/otherbook_1011.qmd), in all of which I know there are characteristic bits.[^1] I have just down the year of revolutions, but I cannot finish off the beginning without more authorities.

The [Annals](other_books/otherbook_1013.qmd) are very useful. Unluckily this copy has Sheet M twice over, and no sheet N but I do not think there is  anything very important in the missing one[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge		

Perhaps I ought to see Madame Bunsen’s [memoirs](other_books/otherbook_1012.qmd)

No books come - so if you would kindly get them for me

---

[^1]: These books were all wanted for CMY's work on *Victorian Half-Century*.
[^2]: Craik had presumably provided her with the most recent (1880) edition of Joseph Irving, *The Annals of our Time*.
